title: Security key
intro: Your security key encrypts your key backup. After generating it, write it down offline and keep it safe.
trust_notice: Only you hold the private key. The server cannot read your messages and cannot recover your key.
passphrase_hint: Optional: protect the recovery key with a passphrase. Leave empty to generate a random key.
no_screenshot_hint: Do not take a screenshot. Write it down on paper and store it safely.
acknowledge: I have written it down and understand it cannot be recovered
success_desc: Security key is set up. Make sure you have saved the recovery key.
failed_desc: Generating the security key failed. Please retry.
